These headers are vendored from https://github.com/ReFil/zmk/tree/adv360-z3.5-2/app/include/dt-bindings/zmk at revision `adv360-z3.5-2`. They are licensed under the MIT license; individual files retain their copyright and SPDX notices.

`behavior-bindings.json` records the public behavior names and binding-cell counts from the same revision's `app/dts/behaviors.dtsi` and included behavior files. Its examples use parameter macros from the vendored headers; it keeps the picker catalog aligned to the firmware version.
